scenario: LTIM.7.1: `t.floor(d)` truncates `t` to the nearest preceding `d` boundary. Pin: the member form on a `Time` with a `Duration` argument compiles. It is a member of `Time`, distinct from the numeric `floor(x)` function, which keeps its one-argument function form ([LEXP.3.2]).
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule r:
    Event m where m.fired_at.floor(1_h) == m.fired_at
->
    log info "x"
